description: Infrastructures Recharge de Véhicules Electriques (IRVE) is a dataset listed in data.melunvaldeseine.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SDESM 77. Données statiques IRVE (Infrastructures Recharge de Véhicules Electriques) Recensement des installations du réseau EcoCharge77 appartenant au Syndicat Départemental des É nergies de Seine-et-Marne. Coverage: Melun Val de Seine (Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Mobilités. Its keywords are recharge, véhicules électriques, IRVE, énergie. The portal shows 66 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melunvaldeseine-fr-portal.
